summary: Jenifer Ann Driver (known as Mountain Sun) last seen in the North Crestone Campground area near Crestone, believed possibly headed to hike to North Crestone Lake; reported missing October 29; Saguache County Sheriff's Office launched an extensive foot and helicopter search that found nothing; the sheriff said evidence pointed to a possible self-inflicted situation; the case remains open and the hiker unlocated.
location: North Crestone Campground / North Crestone Lake area, near Crestone
responding_agency: Saguache County Sheriff's Office / Saguache County Search and Rescue
notes: Date is the last-seen date (2021-10-16, Saturday); reported missing 2021-10-29. Source published 2021-12-10. Inserted run 1016 (Monte Vista Journal chunk).
